newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Purchasing Managers Index rises in April.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Purchasing Managers Index rises in April.

text.p: The Swiss Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) rose to 55.0 percent in April from a revised 53.0 according to Credit Suisse and the Swiss Association for Material Management and purchasing (SVME).
That marked the fourth consecutive monthly rise and matched a level last seen in September 1995. It said increased output and orders on hand were main factors in the April expansion.
The Swiss PMI, published since September 1995, is based on surveys in which companies are asked to rate eight sub-indices as higher, lower or unchanged from the month before.
The categories are production, orders on hand, purchasing volume, purchasing prices, delivery times, inventory purchases, inventory sales and business activity.
